item.title: Reach out and touch faith! Depeche Mode - Violator Album Review
item.description: Depeche Mode's 1990 album "Violator" was the band's first to chart in the top 10 of the Billboard 200, and featured singles such as "Personal Jesus", "Enjoy The Silence", "Policy of Truth" and "World in My Eyes".

item.title: Explore Springfield: Top attractions and must-try restaurants
item.description: Springfield, Missouri offers a diverse array of attractions, from the First Friday Art Walk to the Springfield Cardinals, and a wide variety of cuisines from around the world, making it a great destination for travelers.

item.description: MISSOURI — Before dawn, it looked like a movement. Headlights lined Ozark roads. Families slept in cars. Names were written on tablets nailed to farmhouse walls and later on the doors of a stone clinic. item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — Springfield is moving forward with plans to install a new Route 66 monument — a 20‑foot illuminated crown called Queen’s Gate 66 — but nearby businesses say construction and road closures are already taking a toll. item.title: Temperature records may fall as warming trend takes hold
item.description: A warming trend is expected to bring temperatures into the 60s and 70s over the next few days, with a chance of isolated showers, before a more unsettled and soggy pattern develops in the second half of the week.
